flavor: A narrow, circular corridor where the floor is polished to a mirror sheen. A constant, low-frequency hum vibrates through the soles of your boots, and the air feels unnaturally thin, as if something is being sucked toward the far end of the hall.
name: The Zephyr's Throat
reason: The room is designed to trigger a sudden, high-pressure vacuum event when a weight-sensitive plate is tripped, pulling all loose objects and creatures toward a central vent.
